reader.requirement: At --std 85 an RD must be refused unless it describes at least one body group, that is a DETAIL, CONTROL HEADING or CONTROL FOOTING group (§1985:III.2), including an RD that describes no report group at all.
reader.edition-search: Read ScreenReportGroupCensus (the Groups.Count > 0 && no DE/CH/CF arm); an RD with no groups is refused earlier by COBOL2708 at the RD. grep of the member for DialectLevel, CobolVersion, Constructs., IsCobol85 found nothing.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: both witnesses (census_legal, summary_control_footing_only) are legal; the refusal of an RD with only RH/PH/PF/RF and of an RD with no groups is covered by these probes

probes.printed: EXIT 65; error COBOL2749: RD 'R1' describes no body group
probes.expected: refused: RH, PH, PF, RF only

probes.printed: EXIT 65; COBOL2749 describes no body group (plus COBOL2199 for an absolute LINE in an unpaged report)
EXIT 65; error COBOL2708: RD 'R1' is followed by no report group description entry
probes.expected: refused (degenerate form: no groups at all)
accepted: a CH FINAL alone is a body group; GENERATE report-name presents it

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR7  (3.20.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR7

reader.notes: The 1985 definition of a body group (DETAIL, CONTROL HEADING, CONTROL FOOTING) is the set the census tests. An RD with no group entries never reaches the census (Groups.Count > 0) but is refused by COBOL2708, so the degenerate form is refused too.

refuter.evidence: Body group per §1985:III.2 (DETAIL, CONTROL HEADING, CONTROL FOOTING) is the set ScreenReportGroupCensus tests.
